info.title: Order Management API
info.description: Integer cents, raw PostgreSQL, atomic stock and refresh rotation. Admin operations require current database role=admin. See README for full operational semantics.

Set-Cookie.description: Rotated opaque refresh cookie; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure in production

post.description: Use the cookie jar from login. Consumed-token replay revokes the family; serialize refresh requests.

post.description: Both creation and replay return 201 and the same order ID. Replay returns the current order representation, not cached bytes; no stock changes. Without a key, retries create independent orders.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional, case-sensitive, scoped to the authenticated user and retained with the order. Reuse for retries of the same items (item order and UUID case are ignored). Different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Failed transactions do not consume the key.

patch.description: PENDING → CONFIRMED/CANCELLED; CONFIRMED → SHIPPED/CANCELLED; SHIPPED → DELIVERED. Other transitions return 409.

get.description: Revenue/units use DELIVERED orders and delivered_at (UTC months). Order counts use created_at. Customer history revenue uses delivered_at; order_count/last_order_at use created_at. Low-stock is a current snapshot.
